opportunities.name: Dash AP Flow
opportunities.objective: Test AP on a finite chain of distinct-target E dashes.
opportunities.mechanic: E deals 0.6 AP magic damage and increases subsequent E damage up to four stacks, subject to per-target cooldowns. Cosmic responds to magic damage, Riftmaker rewards extended combat and Lich Bane requires a real follow-up attack. Movement grants Flow, so faster relocation can alter shield availability.
opportunities.requiredState: Several distinct dash targets, E stack duration maintained and finite Flow recorded.
opportunities.failure: Isolated opponents deny E chains; sacrificing crit reduces Q and ordinary attack threat.
opportunities.test: Measure successive E hits on separate targets at zero through four stacks and shield availability after the path.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The same target cannot be redashed immediately simply because E's cast cooldown is short.

opportunities.name: Last Breath three attacks
opportunities.objective: Use R's post-cast armor interaction for a short critical attack follow-up.
opportunities.mechanic: R requires an airborne champion and grants maximum Flow; afterward critical strikes ignore bonus armor for fifteen seconds. Fiendhunter offers three enhanced basic attacks after R and movement from Stridebreaker helps contact. Yasuo's passive doubles crit chance, so a finite crit budget reaches its cap quickly.
opportunities.requiredState: Valid airborne target, R used and three follow-up attacks within the item window.
opportunities.failure: No knockup denies R or peel stops attacks; low enemy bonus armor reduces the special penetration value.
opportunities.test: Compare three post-R attacks versus pre-R against equal total armor with different bonus-armor shares.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: R's bonus-armor ignore is not a blanket reduction to all armor for every spell.

ruledOut.reason: Yasuo builds Flow through movement and does not spend mana.

unknowns: Q primary description explicitly treats it as a basic attack; exact per-target on-hit delivery and modified crit rules still need logs. Passive crit-to-AD token and Fiendhunter critical interaction require live checks.

builds.name: Dash AP Flow
builds.summary: Test AP on a finite chain of distinct-target E dashes.
builds.goal: Test AP on a finite chain of distinct-target E dashes.
builds.hypothesis: E deals 0.6 AP magic damage and increases subsequent E damage up to four stacks, subject to per-target cooldowns. Cosmic responds to magic damage, Riftmaker rewards extended combat and Lich Bane requires a real follow-up attack. Movement grants Flow, so faster relocation can alter shield availability.
testPlan: Required state: Several distinct dash targets, E stack duration maintained and finite Flow recorded.
Measure successive E hits on separate targets at zero through four stacks and shield availability after the path.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Isolated opponents deny E chains; sacrificing crit reduces Q and ordinary attack threat.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: The same target cannot be redashed immediately simply because E's cast cooldown is short.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Cosmic Drive, Riftmaker, Lich Bane, Nashor's Tooth, Rabadon's Deathcap, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Yasuo thrusts, dealing [20 / 45 / 70 / 95 / 120 + (1.05) × AD] physical damage. If he hits, he gains a stack for [6] seconds. While he has 2 stacks, his next use of this Ability fires a whirlwind from range, dealing the same damage and Knocking Up for [1] second.

If used while dashing, this Ability strikes in a circle rather than a stab.

Yasuo dashes through a target, dealing [70 / 85 / 100 / 115 / 130 + (0.2) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.6) × AP] magic damage. Each use of this Ability grants [(70 / 85 / 100 / 115 / 130 + (0.2) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.6) × AP) × (0.25)] bonus damage to subsequent uses for [5] seconds, stacking up to [4] times.

This Ability has a [10 / 9 / 8 / 7 / 6] second per-target Cooldown.

Resolve: Moving grants Flow, which is tracked on Yasuo's resource bar. Moving faster grants more Flow. At maximum Flow, damage from a champion or monster briefly grants [characterLevelInterpolation(125 → 600; raw flags preserved)] Shield.

Intent: Yasuo's Critical Strike Chance is increased by [100]% but his Critical Strike Damage is reduced to [(1) × Stat(9)]. Gain @YasuoCritToAD*.01@ Bonus Attack Damage for every 1% Critical Strike Chance above 100%.
